rubric.role_summary: Senior or Lead Wealth Management Advisor providing financial planning, investment proposals, and ongoing service to high-net-worth clients. The level depends on experience and professional designations.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior or Lead Wealth Management Advisor providing financial planning, investment proposals, and ongoing service to high-net-worth clients. The level depends on experience and professional designations.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- For the Senior Advisor level, 5+ years of experience in wealth management or financial advisory roles.
- For the Lead Advisor level, 10+ years of experience in wealth management or financial advisory roles, specifically working with HNW/UHNW clients.
- Track record of client service.
- Financial planning and investment management knowledge.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): Canada. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Remote candidates must currently be located in one of these areas; remote work does not remove this geographic condition.
